name: No results
summary: An empty search that repeats what was searched and where, then offers the ways to widen it: a spelling fix, a wider scope and a cleared date.
use: when a search or lookup returns nothing
a11y: A polite status repeats the outcome, so it is read when a search runs; each way to widen the search is a real button for your app to wire.
notes: The three ways to widen the search are actions for your app to wire; write them from the search that ran (a spelling fix, a wider folder, any date).

use_when: a search, lookup or query returns zero items
avoid_when: the list is empty because nothing exists yet: use empty-first-use
only filters removed the items: use empty-filtered

parts.name: query
parts.what: what the person searched for, as in “quartely report”

parts.name: message
parts.what: one or two sentences: what it means and what to do next, as in “We searched file names and contents in Finance, ”

parts.name: spelling
parts.what: the Search for “quarterly report” instead action

parts.name: label
parts.what: the visible label, as in “Search for “quarterly report” instead”

parts.name: all_folders
parts.what: the Search all folders, not only Finance action

empty.how: This part is the empty state itself.

loading.how: Not applicable: shown after the data has loaded and come back empty; while loading, show a skeleton.

error.how: Not applicable: an error isn't an empty list. Use page-banners or page-error.

disabled.how: No control here is ever disabled; each one always does something.

overflow.how: Actions stack full width under 30rem; the panel caps its width.

long_text.how: Titles balance and body text wraps at word boundaries inside a capped measure.

keyboard: Tab moves through the three ways to widen the search; Enter or Space picks one
